title: Car Evolution Pro : Math Gates
desc: Car Evolution Pro : Math Gates turns math practice into a race! Drive down the road to the question gates. Each gate shows a math problem with two answer lanes &mdash; steer through the correct one. Answer enough correctly to pass the level and unlock a brand-new part for your car. Watch it evolve from a bare frame into a fully built machine, level by level.
howto: bull Swipe left right or use the arrow keys to steer bull A math question appears above each gate mdash drive through the lane with the correct answer bull Answer enough questions correctly to pass the level bull Every level you pass unlock
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
